data.body: SESSION OPEN AND CONTINUITY. Continues the plan-review bake-off whose Wave 1 and Wave 2 record is session log 4d1f-8149-f3b8-4790 (fungal-protected-seaslug, 26 comments); that log stays the authority for those waves. New log because this is a new session on the restored workstation. Study at /Users/joeoakhart/plan-review-bakeoff, independent of the rebar tracker. Cost and spend figures are deliberately excluded from this log and kept in local-only reports. NOTE FOR THE OWNER: comment 7 of the earlier log contains per-run unit costs with the currency symbol stripped; that is the class of figure the local policy keeps off the public tickets branch, and it predates this session. Flagged, not edited, because redacting published tickets-branch history is an owner decision.
